bugs.description: save_checkpoint writes directly to the durable checkpoint path instead of replacing it only after a complete temporary write.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: The writer raises after emitting only part of the new checkpoint, such as when storage fills.
bugs.observableImpact: The last valid checkpoint is truncated and cannot be decoded during recovery.
bugs.provenance: Seeded mutation replacing a same-directory temporary file and os.replace with a direct write. The interruption is deterministic in test_checkpoint.py.
